import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class SafeHash implements java.util.function.Function<Long, Long> {
        private static long splitmix64(long x) {
            x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
            return x ^ (x >> 31);
        }

        @Override
        public Long apply(Long x) {
            final long FIXED_RANDOM = splitmix64(System.nanoTime() * (randomAddress() | 1));
            return splitmix64(x ^ FIXED_RANDOM);
        }

        private long randomAddress() {
            // simulate random address
            return new Object().hashCode() & 0xffffffffL;
        }
    }

    static class ModInt {
        int val;
        static final int MOD = 1000000007;

        public ModInt(long v) {
            if (v < 0)
                v = v % MOD + MOD;
            if (v >= MOD)
                v %= MOD;
            this.val = (int) v;
        }

        public static int modInv(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                int tmp = g; g = r; r = tmp % r;
                tmp = x; x = y; y = tmp - q * y;
            }
            return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
        }

        public ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInv(val, MOD));
        }

        public ModInt pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            ModInt a = new ModInt(val);
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1)
                    result = result.multiply(a);
                a = a.multiply(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            int newVal = this.val + other.val;
            if (newVal >= MOD)
                newVal -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(newVal);
        }

        public ModInt subtract(ModInt other) {
            int newVal = this.val - other.val;
            if (newVal < 0)
                newVal += MOD;
            return new ModInt(newVal);
        }

        public ModInt multiply(ModInt other) {
            long product = (long) this.val * other.val;
            return new ModInt(product % MOD);
        }

        public ModInt divide(ModInt other) {
            return this.multiply(other.inv());
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof ModInt)) return false;
            ModInt modInt = (ModInt) o;
            return val == modInt.val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(val);
        }

        public int get() {
            return val;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        int N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());

        ModInt[][] probability = new ModInt[N][N];

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = Integer.parseInt(parts[j]);
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).divide(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }

        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        Arrays.fill(lookup, -1);
        // Precompute popcount using Integer.bitCount later

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        Map<Long, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        long firstKey = 1L << lookup[0];
        possibleMasks.put(firstKey, new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            Map<Long, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            int size = 1 << N;

            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[size];
            Arrays.fill(products, new ModInt(1));
            for (int current = 0; current < size; current++) {
                ModInt prodVal = new ModInt(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    if ((current >> right & 1) == 1)
                        prodVal = prodVal.multiply(probability[left][right]);
                    else
                        prodVal = prodVal.multiply(new ModInt(1).subtract(probability[left][right]));
                }
                products[current] = prodVal;
            }

            long[] newBits = new long[N];
            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = entry.getKey();
                ModInt prob = entry.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(newBits, 0);
                for (int maskIdx = 0; maskIdx < masksWithCount.get(left).size(); maskIdx++) {
                    int maskVal = masksWithCount.get(left).get(maskIdx);
                    if (((possible >> lookup[maskVal]) & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if (((maskVal >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                int newMaskVal = maskVal | (1 << i);
                                newBits[i] |= 1L << lookup[newMaskVal];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Map<Long, ModInt> tempMap = new HashMap<>();
                long[] newPossible = new long[1 << N];
                Arrays.fill(newPossible, 0);

                for (int current = 1; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                    int ctzVal = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current);
                    long prev = newPossible[current & (current - 1)];
                    newPossible[current] = prev | newBits[ctzVal];
                    ModInt val = prob.multiply(products[current]);
                    long key = newPossible[current];
                    tempMap.put(key, tempMap.getOrDefault(key, new ModInt(0)).add(val));
                }
                newPossibleMasks = tempMap;
            }
            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
        }

        // Find answer
        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        int lastIndex = (1 << N) - 1;
        int lastBit = lookup[lastIndex];
        for (Map.Entry<Long, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            long key = entry.getKey();
            if (((key >> lastBit) & 1) == 1) {
                answer = answer.add(entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.get());
    }
}
